message.content: Added `part filter : FuelFilter` to Vehicle, replaced the direct tank→engine connection with tank.fuelOut→filter.inlet and filter.outlet→engine.fuelIn, and retyped `FuelFilter::inlet` from LegacyFuelPort to FuelPort so it matches the tank's conjugate port; the model validates with no errors.

raw.text: Added `part filter : FuelFilter` to Vehicle, replaced the direct tank→engine connection with tank.fuelOut→filter.inlet and filter.outlet→engine.fuelIn, and retyped `FuelFilter::inlet` from LegacyFuelPort to FuelPort so it matches the tank's conjugate port; the model validates with no errors.
